MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 12
   C. 8
   D. 11

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 5

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 21

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 48

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

10. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 5

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

16. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
